Content: An astronaut hits a golf ball of mass `m` on the `text(Moon)`, where there is no atmosphere and the acceleration due to gravity is `g//6`, where `g` is the acceleration due to gravity on `text(Earth)`. Assume that the golf club is in contact with the ball for a time `t`. Just after losing contact with the club, the ball has an initial speed `v` directed at an angle `theta` above the horizontal.
